'''January 2001 Hatfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hatfield, England on 21 January 2001. [[Peter Di Biasio]] won it. It is known from Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1662">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-23-hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebsd1662/ hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebs], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 23 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-23-hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebsd1662/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Hatfield, England
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Peter Di Biasio]]
